## File: facebookresearch_mephisto/mephisto/abstractions/providers/mturk/utils/script_utils.py

Prompts

```
['assign an MTurk qualification to a list of worker IDs using direct_assign_qual_mturk_workers', 'soft block a list of MTurk workers by assigning them a blocking qualification via direct_soft_block_mturk_workers', 'retrieve the MTurk assignment ID, HIT ID, and worker ID from a Mephisto unit ID using get_mturk_ids_from_unit_id', 'review the direct_assign_qual_mturk_workers function to understand how qualifications are assigned to MTurk workers', 'summarize the get_mturk_ids_from_unit_id function and how it extracts MTurk IDs from a Mephisto unit']
```
